content: So, what's on the menu for dinner tonight?
You're not going to make anything to eat?
You never cook. I always do.
I think you're a better cook than I am.
Oh please, you need to cook tonight.
So you're telling me that you want me to make dinner?
It was a hard day. Can you just do this for me tonight?
I'm going to go rest for a little bit.
I'll come wake you when it's ready, okay?
